explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/855 (the second Hardy–Littlewood conjecture): is π(x+y) ≤ π(x) + π(y) for large x and y? Open, and probably false under prime k-tuples (Hensley–Richards). The statement asserts the inequality eventually in the product filter atTop ×ˢ atTop, i.e. for all x, y ≥ N, matching 'for large x and y'. Faithful.
